description: Cleaning types, suction levels and water flows the robot supports, refreshed on every discovery. set-cleaning-mode values outside these lists are rejected before dispatch.

items.description: What a cleaning robot does: vacuum only, mop only, or vacuum and mop together. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.
Vacuum suction level, ordered from off to strongest. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.
Mop water flow level, ordered from off to highest. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.
